name: br_cnpj_recognizer
note: CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica), 14 characters, two mod-11 check digits. Since July 2026 the Receita Federal also issues alphanumeric CNPJs (IN RFB 2.229/2024): the first 12 characters may be A-Z or 0-9, the check digits stay numeric, and each character counts as its ASCII code minus 48. The formatted pattern takes both forms; the unformatted pattern takes only the 14-digit form, as 14 bare letters and digits are too common to scan for.
